At ProMach, we look for people who want to shine. Here, you can grow your career, share bold ideas, and make a real impact.

Do we have your attention? Keep reading.

Zarpac is a leading global provider of packaging line engineering, integration, and productivity solutions. We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineer to join our team in Oakville.

This role is ideal for a design-focused engineer who enjoys developing complete electrical systems and seeing their designs come to life in complex, automated packaging environments.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the development of complete electrical design packages, including BOMs, schematics, layouts, and assembly drawings
Own the end-to-end electrical design for machine and/or full packaging lines, ensuring alignment with customer specifications and internal standards
Review and validate design documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
Interpret customer requirements, functional specifications, and vendor documentation
Design and coordinate power distribution systems, including MCCs and PDPs
Develop electrical layouts and system architecture for automated packaging lines
Provide technical guidance during build, testing, and commissioning phases
Collaborate and/or participate with controls teams to support PLC/HMI integration as needed
Contribute to design improvements, standardization, and innovation initiatives
Select components with a focus on performance, cost efficiency, and maintainability

Qualifications

5–10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering with a strong design focus
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical engineering or equivalent
Strong communication and critical thinking skills
Experience in industrial equipment, packaging, or manufacturing environments
Strong expertise in electrical system design and low-voltage power distribution (up to 600V)
Experience developing schematics, panel layouts, and system architecture
Proficiency in AutoCAD (or equivalent design tools)
Understanding of industrial networks and system integration
Experience with PLC programming (Allen Bradley/Siemens)
Experience with FactoryTalk, Wonderware, or similar platforms is an asset
Exposure to robotics, servo systems, and VFDs is an asset
P.Eng. designation is an asset
Strong communication and technical documentation skills
Knowledge of North American electrical standards

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $105,000 – $130,000 CAD.

Travel Requirement

Approximately 20-25% travel, primarily to customer sites in the U.S. Occasional international travel may be required.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing job vacancy.

What’s in it for you?

There's no monopoly on innovative ideas or limits to how far you can advance with our team. We offer an open, communicative environment that fosters individual initiative. We pride ourselves in being a company where people are happy and choose to build a career.

In addition to growth opportunities, as a ProMach employee, you receive more than just a paycheck. Total compensation includes your salary, a comprehensive medical/dental program, as well as a generous paid time off program, and a retirement savings plan with a company match (starting day one!). And because we understand the importance of feeling protected, you are eligible after three months of employment!

#PMISCA

Pro Mach, Inc. was named to the Inc. 5,000 list of the fastest growing private companies in the U.S. seven times. We continue to introduce innovative products, enter new markets, expand our global presence, and actively acquire new capabilities.

We have the rewards, opportunities, and the market strength of a large organization combined with the entrepreneurial culture of a small, fast-paced company. You will enjoy the benefits of working with a growing company that competes globally, with the personal touch and feel of a smaller company where you can make an impact every day.

Curious about life at ProMach? Follow us on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Instagram!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
